ZIRCON TRIDENT.description: A truly retro spear crafted from jewels. Amazing for two dimensional hordes. Halloween 2020 Melee.
ZIRCON TRIDENT.name: ZIRCON TRIDENT

LONGSWORD.description: A traditional European longsword forged from the finest steel. Lower damage with a slightly slower swing time.
LONGSWORD.name: LONGSWORD

NORDIC WAR AXE.description: An ornamental war axe that's still incredibly lethal. Make sure it's the last sunset they'll see. Moderate range with moderate damage and slower swings.
NORDIC WAR AXE.name: NORDIC WAR AXE

ZERO CUTTER.description:
Summon a glass construct blade that cuts through robots as if they were merely air.
High-speed attacks that have combo potential!
Model by Shay.
ZERO CUTTER.name: ZERO CUTTER

REAPER.description: A vintage scythe, sharpened and ready to mow. When you hold it, your blood runs cold, but you're not entirely sure why. High damage with short range and slow swings.
REAPER.name: REAPER

NOOBSLAYER.description:
May the red light of holy judgement give mercy to those who dare oppose you.
Rip and tear through foes with sweeping attacks!
Halloween 2020 Melee made by Vic.
NOOBSLAYER.name: NOOBSLAYER

TRAINING BAYONET.description:
Unlocked with the MOSIN NAGANT.
Wooden training rifle outfitted with an original M1891 bayonet. Perfect for stabbin' fools!
Insane amount of reach.
Bayonet model by ILLAXIS.
TRAINING BAYONET.name: TRAINING BAYONET

ZWEIHANDER.description:
A sword truly made for war. Blade long enough to split the skys. Slow speed, high damage.
Model made by Makosushi and Tammy.
ZWEIHANDER.name: ZWEIHANDER

WORLD BUSTER.description: Foretold in legends one who wields the blade of world's end would rise and bring terror to the land. Functions similarly to the Long Sword.
WORLD BUSTER.name: WORLD BUSTER

NAGINATA.description: A pole weapon utilized by the ancient samurai, but most iconically by the female warriors called onna-bugeisha.
NAGINATA.name: NAGINATA

CHOSEN ONE.description:
Powerful beam-sword from a galaxy far, far away. It is an elegant weapon for a more civilized age.
High damage with a balanced moveset from all three styles of combat.
Model by Shay.
CHOSEN ONE.name: CHOSEN ONE

ICEMOURNE.description:
A blade forged from a frost giant, his hate for humanity glistens bright in the blade. Northern lights expel when the blade is swung. Good damage and range.
Made by Shaylan007.
ICEMOURNE.name: ICEMOURNE

FIRE AXE.description:
A chopping tool used by firefighters to save lives by clearing debris in their way. Also used by maniacs who become a dull boy...
Hippity hoppity I'm choppin' down your property!
FIRE AXE.name: FIRE AXE

HATTORI.description: A Tetsugawa katana favored by ronin, travelling samurai that serve no master. Long range with high damage and fast swings.
HATTORI.name: HATTORI

HARVESTER.description:
They say through the realm of unseen power there comes a dark scythe whose powerful blade can only be seen while swinging. That weapon now rests in your hands. Average swing speed and damage, but quick sprint speed for its size.
Designed by Vic.
HARVESTER.name: HARVESTER
